title: shutil.which lies: harness now resolves absolute tool paths

Harness evolution: nasm-build.py resolves the absolute tool path by filesystem glob (OXENFORD_NMAKE) and smoke-spawns nmake /? before building; resolution-by-search is gone from the build path.

Symptom of violation is a path that looks right in the command but wrong in the error.
